description: Submit feedback on a search result to improve future accuracy. Helps the self-learning engine tune verification thresholds.

rating.description: Rate the result: 'good' (accurate), 'bad' (not helpful), or 'wrong' (factually incorrect)

result_id.description: The shareId/resultId from a previous search result

name: feedback
